text: And the poor men around him!
They were poor because they were vicious, out of the pale of his sympathies because they had not his iron nature, and the capabilities that it gives him for being rich.
translation: 그들은 사악했기 때문에 가난했고, 그의 강철 같은 본성과 그것이 그에게 부자가 될 수 있는 능력이 없었기 때문에 그의 동정심이 창백했습니다.

text: I'm sorry, but I can't help you.
I'm afraid I can't help you.
translation: 제가 당신을 도와드릴 수 없을 것 같습니다.
